mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (user_id, knowledge_base_id, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, knowledge_base_id, title, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
